name: Tulane University/Ochsner Clinic Foundation Program
program_length_note: 6-year program through the 2012 entrants (Kahn grad 2018 after PGY-6); 7-year from the 2013 entrants (Umansky grad 2020).
complement_note: Program history article (Neurosurgery 2019): 'We alternate between taking 1 and 2 residents a year'. Observed: 1/yr 2006-2015 entrants, then 2,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1(2024, Bych),1(2025),2(2026).
history_note: Tulane-sponsored program renamed Tulane University/Ochsner Clinic Foundation in 2009 after LSU withdrew from Ochsner (2008). Ochsner had no separate neurosurgery residency in the study window (it was an LSU site 1993-2008). No Ochsner-hosted roster pages exist (ochsner.org, education.ochsner.org, academics.ochsner.org checked).

hosts.url: https://sites.google.com/site/tulanensurg/ (anatomy lab site linked from 2011-12 dept page; no roster)

gap_details.2011-2012: Significant. Dept site first captured Nov 2011 (home page only); meet-our-residents.cfm first captured Feb 2013; Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2012 has nothing on the host. Reconstructed 6 (1/yr, all alumni-confirmed and seen 2012-13). An unseen 2011 departure could not be detected.
gap_details.2012-2013: Observed from Feb 2013 (only capture). 6 residents, 1 per PGY.
gap_details.2014-2015: Significant. The current-residents page was never updated in 2014-15: Wayback (Mar/May 2015) and Common Crawl (Oct/Nov/Dec 2014) all show the Aug 2013 list. Reconstructed Valle, Caralopoulos, Garces, Kahn, Umansky (bracketed/alumni) and Riffle PGY-1 (alumni grad 2021; first listed PGY-2 2015-16).
gap_details.2017-2018: Observed, Jan 2018 (Sep 2017 capture had PGYs not yet advanced).
gap_details.2018-2019: Observed only via Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2019-18 (2019-04-25); Wayback has no capture. INCOMPLETE: the senior residents Umansky and Shamsnia (PGY-6; alumni grads 2020) are not listed. PHASE2: Umansky/Shamsnia PGY-6 added as reconstructed.
gap_details.2019-2020: Observed Sep 2019. INCOMPLETE: PGY-7s Umansky and Shamsnia (alumni grads 2020) not listed. PHASE2: Umansky/Shamsnia PGY-7 added as reconstructed.
gap_details.2020-2021: Significant. No Wayback capture of any roster URL between Sep 2019 and Jan 2022; Common Crawl 2020-2021 has no medical-resident/neurosurgery record (CC-MAIN-2021-25 index failed once and returned 0 on retry). Reconstructed 10 (bracketed + alumni Riffle, Vidalis). Not reconstructed: Duddleston (2020 intern, first seen PGY-2 2021-22) and Lieber (first seen PGY-6 2021-22). PHASE2: added Lieber PGY-5 (PMID 32474091) and Duddleston PGY-1 (NPI 2020-03-29, Tulane address).
gap_details.2022-2023: Significant. No roster capture Mar 2022-Apr 2024 (Wayback, Common Crawl 2022-2023). Only a single profile page (Naser Ibrahim PGY-2, Oct 2022) loaded as 'other'. Reconstructed 7 bracketed residents. Not reconstructed: the PGY-7 class (Lockwood, Scullen, Lieber; last seen PGY-6 2021-22, alumni page stops at 2022) and Michelle Miller (2022 intern, first seen PGY-2 Apr 2024). PHASE2: added Lockwood/Scullen/Lieber PGY-7 (completed 2023: UCI and UB fellow pages, PubMed, NPPES) and Miller PGY-1 (NPI 2022-04-01).
gap_details.2024-2025: Observed Feb 2025 (identical to Jul 2024). Possibly INCOMPLETE: no PGY-1 listed; Brendan Bych (NPI enumerated 2024-03 New Orleans; PGY-3 in 2026-27) is probably a 2024 intern omitted from the page. PHASE2: Bych PGY-1 added as reconstructed (NPI 2024-03, PMID 39593786).
gap_details.2025-2026: Observed Sep 2025. Bych listed PGY-1 (inconsistent with PGY-3 in 2026-27).
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page 2026-09-27, differs from 2025-26 (new interns Backlund, Kramer). Janssen still listed PGY-7 (was PGY-7 in 2025-26; either extended or stale entry).

irregularities: Brendan Bych: labelled PGY-1 in 2025-26 and PGY-3 in 2026-27 (profile). Evidence (NPI 2024-03, PMID 39593786 Nov 2024) supports 2024 entry, so the 2025-26 label is wrong.
Andrew Janssen: PGY-7 in both 2025-26 and 2026-27 (extended, or a stale entry). McCormack from the same class completed.
Lieber: WSU PGY-4 in 2018-19 but Tulane PGY-6 in 2021-22 and finished 2023, so Tulane re-numbered him one year back (or he repeated a year).
Tulane/Ochsner hosts non-categorical neurosurgery-track trainees (Raju 2015-16, Carr 2018-22, Spinelli 2021-22) who publish under the program's name but are not on the roster.

adjudication_summary.note: After phase 2: Lockwood, Scullen and Lieber completed in 2023. No attrition in 2011-2026. Hanna, Mathkour, Glynn and McCormack are counted COMPLETED from PGY-7 rosters.

problems: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2020-24 (clinical-sciences prefix) and CC-MAIN-2021-25 (medical-resident prefix) had index-range failures on the first pass. A retry succeeded with 1 and 0 records, none a roster. The cclocal scan of tulane.edu/som for 2012-2016 was stopped at CC-MAIN-2016-07, after the 2014-15 captures were found to be stale; 2016-17 onward is observed on Wayback. The live alumni page returns access-denied (403). Phase 2: CC-MAIN-2025-30 index range failed for medical-resident/neurosurgery (not needed; 2025-26 is observed). The Ochsner GME our-residents scan was stopped after the radiology hit; later pages were not scanned.

2011-2012.reason: No capture exists (gap audit 2011-06..2012-12: only 2 dept URLs, CC has nothing). Complement was 1/yr, every PGY1-6 slot in Feb 2013 is held by a continuing resident, and all 6 reconstructed residents are alumni-confirmed. PubMed 2011-12 shows no other trainee.

2014-2015.reason: The page was stale all year (CC Oct/Nov/Dec 2014 recaptured in phase 2 still show the 2013-14 list). Bracketed by the 2013-14 and Mar 2016 rosters, both 1/PGY; alumni confirm Mbabuike 2014 and Valle 2015; Riffle (2014 intern) is alumni-confirmed. A second 2014 intern leaving within the year is the only undetectable case, and the complement was 1.

2018-2019.reason: CC Apr 2019 roster lists PGY1-5. The omitted seniors (Umansky, Shamsnia, PGY-6) were added as reconstructed; both are bracketed by 2017-18 and the 2020 alumni list.

2019-2020.reason: Sep 2019 roster lists PGY1-6. The omitted PGY-7s Umansky and Shamsnia were added (alumni grads 2020).

2020-2021.reason: No capture. Every 2019-20 resident reappears in Jan 2022 or on the alumni list. Joiners: Lieber (PMID 32474091, Sep 2020, Wayne State + Tulane), Vidalis (UNM closure, 2021 grad) and Duddleston (NPI 2020-03-29 at the Tulane neurosurgery address). The 2020 class had 1 slot in the 1/2 alternation.

2022-2023.reason: No roster capture. Everyone in 2021-22 is accounted for: the PGY-7s finished in 2023 (Lockwood, UCI skull-base fellow 2023-24; Scullen, Buffalo endovascular fellow 2023-24; Lieber, Tulane+NSU Oct 2023 and FL license). The others reappear Apr 2024. Miller (2022 intern) has an NPI dated 2022-04-01 at the Tulane address. Nachar was NOT here: she was an Ochsner diagnostic radiology intern.

2024-2025.reason: The Feb 2025 page is unchanged from Jul 2024 and omits the 2024 intern. Bych was added as a reconstructed PGY-1 (NPI 2024-03-27 at the Tulane address, PMID 39593786 Nov 2024 Tulane Neurosurgery, live profile PGY-3). Seniors and all others are bracketed by 2023-24 and 2025-26.
